queries: WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), mm AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mm.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN mm WHERE r.rate > mm.mean_rate

WITH r AS (SELECT m.Name AS name, AVG(1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(t.Bytes) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.Name), mm AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mm.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN mm WHERE r.rate > mm.mean_rate

WITH per_type AS (
  SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS name,
         AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / t.Milliseconds) AS rate,
         COUNT(*) AS track_count
  FROM Track t
  JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId
  GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM per_type
)
SELECT p.name, p.rate, p.track_count, p.rate - o.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean
FROM per_type p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE p.rate > o.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Track count is the number of all tracks matched to the media type, including tracks whose Bytes is NULL and so have no ratio.

Bytes is multiplied by 1.0 so the per-track division is not integer division. Media types are grouped by name, and the overall mean is the plain average of the per-type rates, with types that have no computable rate skipped.

alternatives.interpretation: Track count only includes tracks that have a computable ratio (non-NULL Bytes).

assumptions.assumption: Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId and Name (the name is shown). Track_count counts all matched tracks of the type, including those with NULL Bytes, which are skipped only in the rate average.
The mean of rates is taken over media types that have a defined rate (types with at least one track with non-null Bytes). Types whose rate is NULL are excluded from the mean by AVG.
Milliseconds is NOT NULL, and is assumed non-zero, so there is no division by zero. Bytes is cast to REAL to avoid integer division.

responses.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name, AVG(t.Bytes * 1.0 / t.Milliseconds) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS track_count FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), mean AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS mean_rate FROM r) SELECT r.Name, r.rate, r.track_count, r.rate - mean.mean_rate AS rate_minus_mean FROM r CROSS JOIN mean WHERE r.rate > mean.mean_rate

assumptions.assumption: Track count is the number of matched tracks per media type, including tracks whose Bytes/Milliseconds ratio is missing (NULL Bytes or zero Milliseconds); only the average skips those.
Media types are grouped by MediaTypeId (with name), and the overall mean is the plain average of the per-type rates, with types having no computable rate left out of that mean.
Bytes is multiplied by 1.0 so the per-track division is fractional, not integer division.

alternatives.interpretation: Track count only includes tracks that have a computable ratio (the same tracks used in the average).
